name: salamander
character: Salamander Grand Piano: a Yamaha C5 sampled at 16 velocity layers, remapped to SFZ by the sfzinstruments project
licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (a forum post says the original was later relicensed public domain; unverified)
attribution: Salamander Grand Piano, Alexander Holm (SFZ remap: sfzinstruments)

all.what: the library as its author publishes it
all.manual_note: Open the page, download the SFZ instrument, then run: sfz_libs.py install-local salamander <downloaded.zip> --project <dir>. Then name it in an instrument preset: "sfz": {"library": "salamander", "patch": "<path/to/patch>"}.
